sarvārthasiddhi
'pranthakāra eva dviṣā ātmanaṃ vibhajya sūtrakārabhāṣyakāreṇevamāha-śāstīti sūtrakāra iti śeṣaḥ | aśyā paryāyavāt paryāyiṇo bheda ityanyaḥ sūtrakāraparyāyo'nyaca bhāṣyakāraparyāya ityataḥ sūtrakāraparyāyaḥ śāstīti|'
isameṃ batalāyā gayā ki 'granthakārane apaneko sūtrakāra aura bhāṣyakāra isa taraha do bhāgoṃ meṃ vibhakta karaśāsti' aisā kahā hai| isalie yahā~para 'śāsti' kriyāke sātha usake kartākā bodha karāne ke lie 'satrakāra' pada joḍa़ lenā cāhie| athavā paryāyīke bhedase paryāyīko bhinna māna lenā cāhie| ataḥ eka hī granthakārako sūtrakāra paryāya bhinna hai aura bhāṣyakāra paryāya bhinna hai, ata: sūtrakāra paryāyase yukta granthakāra kahate haiṃ aisā sambandha kara lenā cāhie|
aisā hī eka dūsarā ullekha adhyāya doke nirupabhogamantyam' sūtrakī siddhasenīya ṭīkā meṃ milatā hai| isameṃ sūtrakārase bhāṣyakārako abhinna batalāyā gayā hai| ullekha isa prakāra hai
'sūtrakārāvavibhakto'pi hi bhāṣyakārī vibhāgamāvaśaṃyati vyucchitti-(paryāya) nayasamāśrayaṇāta|'
isa prakāra yadyapi ina ullekhoṃse yaha vidita hotā hai ki siddhasena gaṇi tattvārthasūtrakāra aura tattvārthabhāṣyakāra ina donoṃ vyaktiyoṃko eka mānate rahe haiṃ, para itane mātrase yaha nahīṃ mānā jā sakatā ki yaha unakā niścita mata thā| unhoṃne apanī ṭīkāmeṃ kucha aisā bhī abhiprāya vyakta kiyā hai jisake ādhārase vicāra karane para sūtrakārase bhāṣyakāra bhinna siddha hote haiṃ| isake lie adhyāya āṭhake 'matyādīmām' sūtrakī ṭīkā dekhanī cāhie|
yahāṃ para siddhasena gaṇike sāmane yaha praśna hai ki jaba anya ācārya 'matibhutāvaṣimana:paryayakevalāmāma' sūtra mānate haiṃ taba sūtrakā vāstavika rūpa 'matyādīnām' bhānā jāya yā anya ācārya jisa prakāra usakā pāṭha paḍha़te haiṃ vaisā mānā jāya| isa śaṃkākā samādhāna karate hue pahale to unhoṃne hetuoṃkā āśraya liyā hai kintu itane mātrase svayaṃ santoṣa hotā na dekha ve kahate haiṃ ki yataḥ bhāṣyakārane bhī isa satrakā isī prakāra marca kiyā hai ata: 'matyāvīnām' hī sūtra honā cāhie| unakā samasta prasaṃgako vyakta karanevālā ṭīkāvacana isa prakāra hai
'aparesa pratipa paccāpi paṭhanti-matitāvaṣimanaḥparyayakevalānāmiti| evaṃ cāpākāpāṭho lakṣyate| tato'nantarasū pañcāvibhevā jñānāvaraṇādaya ityavatameva | nirmātāśca svaspataḥ prathamādhyāye vyākhyātatvāt | ataḥ ādiśabda eva ca yuktaḥ| bhāṣyakāro'pyevameva sūtrārthamāvevayate|'
___ yahā~ viśeṣa dhyāna dene yogya bhāṣyakāro-' ityādi vacana hai| isa vacana meṃ bhāṣyakārakā sambandha sīdhā matyācīlāma' sūtrakī racanāke sātha sthāpita na kara usake arthake sātha sthāpita kiyā gayā hai| isase siddha hotā hai ki yahā~para siddhasena gaṇi sūtrakārako bhāṣyakārase bhinna māna rahe haiṃ, anyathā ve kisī apekṣāse sūtrakāra aura bhāṣyakāra meṃ abhinnatā sthāpita kara apanī bhāṣādvārā isa prakāra samarthana karate jisase bhāṣyakārase abhinna sūtrakārane hī 'matyādīnām' sūtra racā hai isa bātakā dṛḍha़tāke sātha samarthana hotā|
jahā~ taka hamārā mata hai ina pūrvokta ullekhoṃke ādhārase hama eka mātra isī niṣkarṣa para pahuṃcate haiṃ ki mūla tattvārthasūtrakāra aura tattvārthabhāṣyakāra abhinna vyakti haiṃ isa viṣayameṃ siddhasena gaṇikī sthiti saṃśayāpanna rahī hai, kyoṃki kahīṃ ve tattvārthasūtrakāra aura tattvārthabhāṣyakāra inako eka vyakti māna lete haiṃ aura kahīṃ do| isa sthiti ko dekhate hue mālūma aisā detā hai ki siddhasena gaṇike kāla taka tasvārthabhāṣyakāra hī mūla tattvārthasūtrakāra haiṃ yaha mānyatā dṛḍhamūla nahīṃ ho pāyī thī| yahī kāraṇa hai ki siddhasena gaṇi kisī eka matakā niścayapūrvaka pratipādana karane meṃ asamartha rahe|
paṇḍitajī-isa prakāra siddhasena gaṇikī ṭīkāke ādhārase vācaka umāsvāti tattvārthasūtrake racayitā haiṃ isa bātake anirṇīta ho jāne para bhī yahā~ hameṃ prajñācakṣu paṃ0 sukhalālajīke etadviṣayaka pramāṇoṃkā asagase

parāmarśa kara lenā āvaśyaka pratīta hotā hai| isa viṣaya meṃ unhoṃne jina tīna pramāṇoṃko upasthita kiyā | unakā hama pahale pṛṣṭha 62 meṃ nirdeśa kara āye haiṃ| unameṃse pahalā pramāṇa utthā nikākī 22vīṃ kārikā aṃ: tattvārthabhāṣyake anta meṃ pāyī jānevālī praśasti hai| ina donoṃ sthaloṃmeṃse utthānikā kārikāmeṃ tattvārthādhigama nāmaka laghugranthake kahanekī pratijñā kī gayī hai aura antima praśastimeṃ vācaka umāsvātine tattvārthādhigama śāstra racā yaha kahā gayā hai| paṇḍitajī isa ādhārase yaha siddha karanā cāhate haiṃ ki tattvārthasūtra ke kartā vācaka umāsvāti hī haiṃ| kintu hama yaha pahale (pṛṣṭha 17 meṃ) hī siddha karake batalā āye haiṃ ki tattvārthādhigama yaha nāma tattvārthasūtrakā na hokara tattvārthabhāṣyakā hai| svayaṃ vācaka umāsvāti tattvārthādhigamako sūtra na kahakara use grantha yā śāstra śabda dvārā sambodhita karate haiṃ aura āge tattvārthādhigamake racane kā prayojana batalāte hae 22vīṃ utthānikā kārikāmeṃ kahate haiṃ ki jina vacana mahodadhi durgama granthabhāṣyapāra honese usakā samajhanā kaṭhina hai| aitihāsikoṃse yaha chipī huī bāta nahīṃ hai ki yahā~ vācaka umāsvātine āgama granthoṃ ke jina bhāṣyoṃkā ullekha kiyā hai ve vikrama kī 7vīṃ śatābdīkī racanā haiṃ| jaba ki inake bhī pūrva tattvārthasūtra para sarvārtha siddhi prabhṛti aneka ṭīkāe~ likhī jā cukī thīṃ| aisī avasthā meṃ 21vīṃ utthānikā kārikā aura antima praśastike ādhārase vācaka umāsvātiko mūla tattvārthasūtrakā kartā siddha karanā to koī artha nahīṃ rakhatā|
paṇḍitajī kī dūsarī yukti meṃ kahā gayā hai ki tattvārthabhāṣyake āloḍanase aisā lagatā hai ki tattvārthabhāṣya meṃ sūtrakā artha karane meṃ kahīṃ bhī khīcātānī nahīṃ kī gayī hai ādi | yahā~ vicāra isa bātakā karanā hai ki kyā tattvārthabhāṣyakī vaisī sthiti hai jaisī ki paṇḍitajī usake viṣayameṃ udghoṣaṇā karate haiṃ yā vaisī sthiti nahīṃ hai| isa dṛṣṭi se hamane bhī tattvārthabhāṣyakā āloḍana kiyā hai, kintu hameṃ usameṃ aise aneka sthala dikhāī dete haiṃ jinake kāraṇa isa dṛṣṭi se tattvārthabhāṣyakī sthiti sandehāspada pratīta hotī hai | yathā
1. tattvārthasūtra meṃ samyagdarśanīse samyagdṛṣṭiko bhinna nahīṃ mānā gayā hai| vahāṃ adhyāya 7 sūtra 23 meṃ aise samyagdarśanavāleko bhī samyagdaṣṭi kahā gayā hai jisake śaṃkā ādi doṣa sambhava hote haiṃ| kintu isake viparīta tattvārthabhāṣya meṃ samyagdarśanī aura samyagdṛṣṭi ina donoṃ padoṃkī svatantra vyākhyā karake samyagdarśanīse samyagdṛṣṭiko bhinna batalāyā gayā hai| vahā~ kahā gayā hai ki jisake ābhinibodhika jñāna hotā hai vaha samyagdarśanī kahalātā hai aura jisake kevalajñāna hotā hai vaha samyagdṛṣṭi kahalātā hai| spaṣṭa hai ki yahā~ para tattvārthabhāṣyakāra tattvārthasūtrakā anusaraṇa nahīṃ karate aura samyagdṛṣṭi padakī tattvārthasūtra ke viruddha apanī do vyākhyāeṃ prastuta karate haiṃ| eka sthala (a0 1 sū08) meṃ ve jisa bāta ko svīkāra karate haiṃ dūsare (a07 sū0 23) meṃ ve use choḍa़ dete haiṃ|

isa prakāra ye tīna paramparāeṃ hamāre sāmane haiṃ| inameṃ se tapāgaccha paṭṭāvalike viṣaya meṃ to itanā hī kahanā hai ki dharmasāgara gaṇike sāmane tattvārthabhāṣyako praśasti ke rahate hue jo unhone tapāgaccha ke ācāryoṃkī paramparāke sātha umāsvātikā ullekha kiyā hai so isakā kāraṇa kevala yugapradhāna ācāryake rūpa meṃ umāsvāti. ko unake vāstavya kālake sātha svīkāra karanā mātra hai| jinabhadra gaṇike viṣaya meṃ bhī yahī bāta hai| ye donoṃ tapāgaccha paramparake ācārya nahīṃ haiṃ aura na aisā dharmasāgara gaṇi hī mānate haiṃ| yahī kāraṇa hai ki unhoṃne tapāgaccha paramparākā svatantra nirdeśa karate hue bīca meṃ inakā yugapradhāna ācārya ke rūpa meṃ ullekhamātra kiyā hai, isalie ise aura isake sātha pāyī jānevālī thoḍa़ese matabhedako liye hue anya praśastiyoṃ ko choḍa़ kara hamāre sāmane mukhya do paramparāe~ rahatī haiṃ-eka śravaṇabelgola meṃ pāye jānevāle śilālekhoṃkī paramparā aura dūsarī tasvārthabhāṣyake anta meṃ pāyī jānevālī praśastikī paramparā |

'ta' yā 'ta' ke sthāna meṃ 'ma' likhā jānese ye donoṃ nāma cala paḍa़e hoṃge| isī prakāra umāsvāti yā umāsvābhī nāmakā kahīṃ gṛddhapiccha isa apara nāgake sātha ullekha milane se aura kahīṃ inameṃse kisī ekakā ullekha milanese isa sambandha meṃ bhī yaha kahā jā sakatā hai ki isa taraha pūre yā adhūre nāmake likhane kī bhī paramparā rahī hai aura ho sakatā hai ki usī paramparāke anusāra vividha prakārase ina nāmoṃkā ullekha kiyā jāne lagā hogā|

jinhoṃne lakṣaṇaśāstrakī racanā kī, maiṃ una ācārya pūjyapādako praṇāma karatā hai| unake isa lakṣaṇaśāstrakī mahattā isīse spaṣṭa hai ki jo isameṃ hai vahī anyatra hai aura jo isameṃ nahīṃ hai vaha anyatra bhī nahīṃ hai|

79
hotā hai ki inakā eka nāma 'deva' bhī thā| mālūma paḍa़tā hai ki inakā dīkṣānāma 'devanandi' honese usake saṃkṣipta rūpa 'deva' isa pada dvārā ukta ācāryoṃne inakā nāmollekha kiyā hai| ataeva yaha koī svatantra nāma na hokara 'devanandi' isa nāmakā hī saṃkṣipta rūpa pratīta hotā hai|
3 saṃgha-saṃghoṃkī utpattikā itihāsa indranandine apane śrutāvatāra meṃ diyā hai| ve likhate haiṃ ki jaba sau yojanake muni milakara aṣṭāṃganimittajña aura dhāraṇa-prasāraṇa ādi viśuddha kriyāke pālanevāle ācārya ahaṃbali kī dekharekha meṃ yugapratikramaṇa kara rahe the usa samaya yugake antima dina yugapratikramaṇa karate hue ācārya arhadbaline āye hue munisamājase pūchā ki kyā sabhī yatijana ā gaye haiṃ ? isapara yati janoṃne uttara diyā ki apane-apane sakala saṃghake sātha hama ā gaye haiṃ| taba yatijanoṃke isa uttarako sunakara unhoṃne jāna liyā ki yaha kalikāla hai| isameṃ āge yatijana gaṇapakṣapātake bhedase raheṃge, udāsa bhāvase nahīṃ raheṃge aura aisā vicāra kara unhoṃne jo guphāse āye the unameṃse vinhīṃko 'nandi' saṃjñā dī aura vinhīṃ ko 'vīra' saṃjñā dī| jo aśokavāṭikāse āye the unameṃ se kinhīṃko 'aparājita' saṃjñā dī aura kinhīṃ ko 'deva' saṃjñā dī| jo paṃcastūpake nivāsī vahā~ āye the una meṃse kinhīṃ ko 'sena' saṃjñā dī aura vinhīṃ ko 'bhadra' saṃjñā dī| jo śālmalī mahādrumase āye the una meṃse kinhīṃko gaṇadhara' saṃjñā dī aura kinhīṃ ko 'gupta' saṃjñā dī aura jo khaṇḍakesara dumake mūlase āye the unameṃse kinhīṃko siṃha' saṃjñā dī aura kinhīṃko candra' saṃjñā dī|

9. sārasaṃgraha- ācārya pūjyapādane eka 'sārasaṃgraha' nāmaka granthakā bhī nirmāṇa kiyā thā aisā dhavalāke eka ullekhase jñāta hotā hai | yathā
sārasaṃgrahe'pyaktaṃ pūjyapā-anantaparyāyātmakasya vastuno'nyatamaparyāyādhigame kartavye jātya hetvapekṣo niravadyaprayogo naya iti |'
sarvārthasiddhi meṃ ācārya pūjyapādane jo nayakā lakṣaṇa diyā hai isase isa lakṣaṇameṃ bahuta kucha sāmya hai, isalie yaha mānanekā paryāpta kāraṇa hai ki yaha grantha ācārya pūjyapādakī hī kṛti honī cāhie|
10. cikitsāśāstra- isa bātako siddha karanevāle. bhī kaī pramāṇa milate haiṃ ki ācārya pūjyapādane vaidyaka viṣaya para bhī koī anupama grantha likhā thā| yathā---
1. ācārya śubhacandra dvārā racita jñānārṇavake eka ślokakā ullekha hama pahale kara āye haiṃ| usameṃ unake vacanoṃ ko vacanamala aura cittamalake samāna kāyamalako dūra karanevālā kahā gayā hai|
2. ācārya ugrādityane apane kalyāṇakāraka nāmaka grantha meṃ ācārya pūjyapādake vaidyaka viṣayaka granthakā ullekha 'pūjyapādena bhāṣitaḥ, śālākyaṃ pūjyapādaprakaṭitamadhikam' ityādi śabdasandarbha dvārā kiyā hai|
3. hama pahale śimogā jile ke nagara tāllukeke 46 naṃ0 ke eka śilālekhakā ullekha kara āye haiṃ usameṃ bhī unheṃ manuṣya samājakā hita karanevālā vaidyaka śāstrakā racayitā kahā gayā hai |
4. vikramakī pandrahavīṃ śatābdīke vidvān maṃgarājane apane kanaḍī bhāṣā meṃ likhe gaye khagendramaṇidarpaṇa meṃ bhī ācāryapūjyapādake eka cikitsāgranyakā ullekha kiyā hai|

11. nābhiṣeka-śravaṇabelgolake śaka saṃ0 1085 ke śilālekha naṃ0 40 se yaha bhī vidita hotā hai ki inhoṃne eka jaina abhiṣeka pāṭha kī bhī racanā kī thī| uddharaṇa isa prakāra hai
'jainendra nijaśabdabhogamatalaṃ sarvārthasiddhiḥ parā siddhānte nipuṇatvamudghakavitā jainābhiṣekaḥ svakaḥ | chandassūkṣmadhiyaṃ samāṣiśatakasvāsthyaṃ yadīyaṃ vidām
ākhyātīha sa pūjyapāvamunipaḥ pūjyo munīnāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||' isameṃ kahā gayā hai ki vidvānoṃke samakṣa jinakā jainendra vyākaraṇa atula nija śabda sampattiko, sarvārthasiddhi siddhānta meṃ nipuṇatāko, jaina abhiṣeka kavitākī śreṣṭhatāko aura ātmasvāsthyakara samādhiśataka chandaḥśāstrakī sūkṣmatāko sūcita karatā hai ve ācārya pūjyapāda munigaṇoṃse satata pūjanīya haiṃ|
pahale hama candrayya kavike pūjyapādacarite' ke ādhārase ācārya pūjyapādakī saṃkṣipta jīvanī de āye haiṃ| usameṃ ācārya pūjyapādako jainendra vyākaraṇa aura vaidyakake samāna arhatpratiṣṭhālakṣaṇa aura jyotiṣakā bhī lekhaka batalāyā gayā hai| kaha nahīṃ sakate ki yaha ullekha kahā~ taka ṭhīka hai| yadi yaha sādhāra ho to kahanā hogā ki ācārya pūjyapādane arhatpratiṣṭhā aura jyotiṣa viṣaya para bhī racanā kī thī|
6. samaya-vicāra-ācārya pūjyapāda kaba hue yaha praśna viśeṣa vivādāspada nahīṃ hai| pāṃcavīṃ śatābdī ke madhyakāla se lekara prāyaḥ jitane sāhityakāra haiṃ unhoṃne kisī na kisī rūpa meṃ yā to unakā yā unake sāhityakā ullekha kiyā hai yā unake sāhityakā anuvartana kiyā hai | isa dṛṣṭise hamāre sāmane mukhya rūpase jinabhadra gaṇi kṣamāśramaṇakā viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣya aura akalaṃkadevakā tattvārthavātika upasthita haiṃ | bhaṭṭa akalaṃkadevake sāmane tattvārthavātika likhate samaya sarvārtha siddhi aura jainendravyākaraṇa upasthita thā yaha usake

viśeṣārtha -- isa sūtra meṃ samyagdarśanake lakṣaṇakā nirdeśa karate hue batalāyā hai ki jīvādi padārthoṃke śraddhānako samyagdarśana kahate haiṃ | isa sūtrakī vyākhyā karate hue ṭīkā meṃ mukhyatayā cāra bātoṃko spaṣṭa kiyā gayā hai| ve cāra bāteṃ ye haiṃ- ( 1 ) tattva aura artha śabdake niruktyartha kā nirdeśa karake tattvārtha śabda kaise niṣpanna huā hai ? (2) 'dṛśi' dhātukā artha śraddhāna karanā kyoṃ liyā gayā hai ? ( 3 ) tattva aura artha ina donoṃ padoṃko svīkāra karanese kyā lābha hai ? (4). samyagdarśanake kitane bheda haiṃ aura unakā kyā svarūpa hai ? prakṛtameṃ yadyapi 'tat' sarvanāma pada hai aura 'tva' pratyaya bhāva artha meṃ āyā hai, ataḥ 'tattva' śabda bhāva sāmānyakā vācaka hai aura arthapada dravyavācī hai | tathāpi artha śabda ke dhana, prayojana, abhidheya, nivṛtti, viṣaya, prakāra aura vastu ādi aneka artha pāye jāte haiṃ, ataḥ ina sabakā śraddhāna karanā samyagdarśana na kahalāve, isalie to sūtrakārane sūtra meṃ kevala arthapada nahīṃ rakhā hai| isī prakāra vibhinna matoṃmeṃ tattva śabdake bhī aneka artha prasiddha haiṃ | vaiśeṣika loga 'tattva' padase sattā, dravyatva, guṇatva aura karmatvakā grahaṇa karate haiṃ | unake yahā~ sāmānya aura viśeṣa ye donoṃ svatantra padārtha māne gaye haiṃ | aba yadi sūtra meṃ kevala 'tattva' pada rakhā jātā hai to sattā, dravyatva, guṇatva aura karmatva inakā śraddhāna karanā bhī samyagdarśana samajhā jā sakatā hai jo yukta nahīṃ hai, isalie sūtrakārane sūtrameṃ kevala tattvapada nahīṃ rakhā hai| isī prakāra paramabrahmavādiyoṃne nānā tattvoṃko na mānakara brahmanāmakā eka hī tattva mānā hai | unake matase yaha jaga eka puruṣarūpa hī hai, isalie isa hisāba se vicāra karanepara 'tatva' pada eka brahmakā vācī prāpta hotā hai jo yukta nahīṃ hai, isalie bhī sūtrakārane sūtra meṃ kevala tattvapada nahīṃ rakhā hai | yahā~ tattvārthase jīvādika ve saba padārtha liye gaye haiṃ jinakā āge cauthe sūtra meṃ varṇana kiyā hai| paramārtharūpa kā śraddhāta karanā samyagdarśana hai yaha isa sūtrakā tātparya hai | samyagdarśanameṃ darśana śabda āyā hai| usakā eka artha āloka hotā hai tathāpi yahā~ isakā śraddhāna artha liyā gayā hai, kyoṃki darśanakā jāloka artha lenepara cakṣu ādi nii
neke kāraṇa vaha cakṣurindriya ādi saba saṃsārī jīvoṃke prāpta hotā hai, ataḥ prakṛtameṃ vaha upayo nahī ṭhaharatā | kintu svārtha viṣayaka śraddhāna bhavyoṃ meṃ bhī kisī-kisī āsannabhavyake hī pa jātā hai jo prakṛtameṃ upayogī hai, ataḥ yahā~ darśanakā artha āloka na karake śraddhāna kiyā hai āśaya yaha hai ki jīvādi nau padārthomaṃ bhūtārtharūpase eka trikāloakhaṇḍaātmā hī prayotita ho rahā hai, ataḥ aise nijātmākī anubhūti hī samyagdarśana haiṃ | pratyeka ātmā svayaṃ jñānasvarūpa hai, ataḥ jñānānubhūti hī ātmānubhūti hai aura vahī samyagdarśana hai yaha isakā bhāva hai| prata samyagdarśanake jo do bheda kiye gaye haiṃ-eka sarāya samyagdarśana aura dūsarā vītarāga samyagdarśana so praśama, saṃvega, anukampā aura āstikya ye bāta aise vila haiṃ jo ātmaviśuddhirūpa paramārtha samyagdarśana ke jñāpaka haiṃ| isalie isa apekṣā vyavahāra se inheṃ bhī samyagdarśana hai | kintu ise jo paramārthasvarūpa jānate haiṃ yaha unakī bhūla hai| niyama yaha hai ki jilanī samyagdarśanādi svabhāvaparyāya hotī haiṃ, ve mātra svata. siddha, anādi-ananta, karma se hone ke kāraṇa nitya udyotasvarūpa aura viśada jyotijñāpaka ātmākā apane upayogaka avalambana lenese hī utpanna hotī haiṃ | isīlie bhūlameṃ samyagdarśanarūpa svabhāvaparyāyako ātmaviśuddhimātra kahā hai, kyoṃki yaha mithyātva ādi karmoke udayameṃ na hokara unake upaśama, kṣaya aura kṣayopaśamake hone para hī hotā hai| itanā avaśya hai ki yaha samyagdarśana cauthe ādi guṇasthānoṃ meṃ bhī pāyā jātā hai, ataḥ isake sadbhāvameṃ jo parāśrita praśamādi bhāva hote haiṃ

dravya śrutako nī upacārase śrutajñāna kahā gayā hai| dūsarī bātako spaṣṭa karate hue pramāṇakī śreṣṭhatāmeṃ do hetu diye haiṃ| prathama hetu to yaha diyā hai ki naya prarūpaṇākī utpatti pramāṇajñānase hotī hai, ataḥ pramāṇa śreṣṭha hai | isakā āśaya yaha hai ki jo padārtha pramāṇake viṣaya haiṃ unhīṃ meṃ vivakṣābhedase nayako pravṛtti hotā hai anyama nahīṃ, ata: pramāṇa śreṣṭha hai| dūsarā hetū yaha diyā hai ki sakalādeśa pramāṇake adhīna hai aura vikalādeśa nayake adhīna hai, ataḥ pramāṇa śreṣṭha hai| āśaya yaha hai ki pramāṇa samagrako viṣaya karatā hai aura naya ekadeśa ko viṣaya karatā hai, ata: pramāṇa śreṣṭha hai| jo bacana kālādikakī apekṣā abhedavattikī pradhānatāse yā abhedopapārase pramāṇake dvārā svīkṛta ananta dharmātmaka vastukā eka sātha kathana karatā hai use sakalādeśa kahate haiṃ| aura jo vacana kālādikakī apekṣā bhedavṛttikī pradhānatāse yā bhedopacārase nayake dvārā svīkṛta vastu dharmakā kramase kathana karatā hai use vikalādeśa kahate haiṃ | inameṃ se pramāṇa sakalādeśī hotā hai aura naya vikalādeśī, ata: pramāṇa śreṣṭha mānā gayā hai yaha ukta kathana kā tātparya hai| tīsarī bātako spaṣṭa karate hue nayake dravyāthika aura paryāyāthika aise do bheda karake jo nāmādi tīna nikṣepoṃ ko dravyārthika nayakā aura bhāva nikṣepa ko paryāyāthika nayakā viṣaya batalāyā hai so isakā yaha abhiprāya hai ki nāma, sthāpanā aura dravya ye tīnoṃ nikṣepa sāmānyarūpa haiṃ, ata: inheṃ dravyārthika nayakā viṣaya batalāyā hai aura bhāvanikṣepa paryāyarūpa hai, ata: ise paryāyāthika nayakā viṣaya batalāyā hai| yahā~ itanā viśeṣa jānanā ki nāmako sādaśya sāmānyātmaka māne binā śabdavyavahārakī pravatti nahīṃ ho sakatī hai, isalie nāma nikṣepa dravyāthika nayakā viṣaya hai aura
kī jisameṃ sthāpanā kī jātī hai unameṃ ekatvakā adhyavasāya kiye binā sthāpanā nahīṃ bana sakatī hai, isalie sthāpanā dravyārthika nayakā viṣaya hai| śeṣa kathana sugama hai|

$29. adhikaraṇa do prakārakā hai—abhyantara aura bāhya | abhyantara adhikaraṇa—jisa samyagdarśanakā jo svāmī hai vahī usakā abhyantara adhikaraṇa hai| yadyapi sambandhameṃ ṣaṣṭhī aura adhikaraṇameṃ saptamī vibhakti hotī hai, phira bhī vivakṣāke anusāra kārakakī pravṛtti hotī hai, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhī vibhakti dvārā pahale jo svāmitvakā kathana kiyā hai usake sthānameṃ saptamī vibhakti karanese adhikaraṇakā kathana ho jātā hai | bāhya adhikaraṇa lokanāḍa़ī hai | śaṃkā-vaha kitanī baḍa़ī hai ? samādhāna-eka rāju cauḍa़ī aura caudaha rāju lambī hai|
30. aupaśamika samyagdarśanakī jaghanya aura utkṛṣṭa sthiti eka antarmuhurta hai| kṣāyika samyagdarśanakī saṃsārī jīvake jaghanya sthiti antarmuhūrta hai va utkṛṣṭa sthiti āṭha varṣa aura antamuhūrta kama do pūrvakoṭi adhika tetīsa sāgaropama hai | mukta jīvake sādi-ananta hai | kṣāyopaśamika samyagdarśanako jaghanya sthiti antarmuhūrta hai va utkṛṣṭa sthiti chayāsaṭha sāgaropama hai| 1. kṣāyika samyagdṛṣṭi usī bhavameṃ, tīsare bhavameṃ yā cauthe bhavameṃ mokṣa jātā hai| jo cauthe mavameṃ mokṣa jātā hai vaha pahale maugabhūmimeṃ usake bāda deva paryāyameṃ janma lekara aura anta meṃ manuṣya sambagdarśanake utpanna honeke bhavakā bhī grahaṇa kara liyā hai| saṃsārī jīvake kṣāyika samyagdarśanakī yaha utkṛṣṭa sthiti tīna bhavakī apekṣā batalāyī hai| prathama aura antake do mava manuṣya paryāya ke liye gaye haiṃ aura dūsarā bhava deva paryāyakā liyā gayā hai| ina tīnoṃ bhavoṃkī utkṛṣṭa sthiti do pūrva koṭi adhika tetīsa sāgaropama hotī hai| kintu kṣāyika samyagdarśana kī prāpti āṭha varṣa aura antarmuhūrtake pahale nahīṃ ho sakatī, isalie ukta kālameṃ se itanā kāla kama karake kṣāyika samyagdarśanakī utkṛṣṭa sthiti pāṭha varṣa antarmuhurta kama do pūrva koṭi varṣa adhika tetīsa sāgaropaṇa batalāyī hai| 2. khuddābandhameṃ kṣāyopaśamika samyagdarśanakā utkṛṣṭa kāla chayāsaṭha sāgaropama isa prakāra ghaṭita karake batalāyā hai-eka jīva upaśama samyaktvase vedaka samyaktvako prāpta hokara śeṣa mujyamāna prāyuse kama bīsa sāgaropamakī āyuvāle devoṃmeṃ utpanna humā| phira manuṣyoṃ meṃ utpanna hokara puna: manuṣyāyuse kama bāīsa sāgaropamakī āyuvāle devoṃ meṃ utpanna humā| phira manuṣyagatimeṃ jākara mujyamāna manuṣyāyuse tathā darśanamohakī kṣapaṇā paryanta prāge bhogī jānevālī manuṣyāyuse kama caubīsa sāgaropamakī prāyuvāle devoṃmeṃ utpanna humā| vahā~se phira manuṣya gatimeṃ mākara vahā~ vedaka samyaktvake kāla meṃ antamuhūtaṃ raha jāne para darśanamohakī kṣapaṇākā prārambha karake kṛtakṛtya vedaka samyagdṛṣṭi ho gayā| yaha jīva jaba kṛtakṛtyavedakake antima samaya meṃ sthita hotā hai taba kṣāyopaśamika samyagdarśanakā utkṛṣṭa kāla chayāsaṭha sāgaropama prāpta hotā hai|

[118834 - nātisaṃkṣepeṇa nātivistareṇa pratipādyāḥ | sarvasattvānugrahārtho hi satāṃ prayāsa iti adhigamābhyupāyabhedoddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | itarathā hi "pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ" ityanenaiva siddhatvāditareṣāṃ grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |
834. tatra jīvadravyamadhikṛtya sadādyanuyogadvāranirūpaṇaṃ kriyate| jīvāścaturdaśasu guṇasthāneṣu vyavasthitāḥ | mithyādṛṣṭiḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭiḥ samyamithyādṛṣṭiḥ asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭiḥ saṃyatāsaṃyataḥ pramattasaṃyataḥ apramattasaṃyataḥ apūrvakaraṇasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ anivṛttibādarasāṃparāyasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ sukṣmasāṃparāyasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ upaśāntakaṣāyavītarāgachadamasthaḥ kṣīṇakaṣāyavītarāgachadmasthaḥ sayogakevalī ayogakevalī ceti | eteṣāmeva jīvasamāsānāṃ nirūpaṇārtha caturdaśa mārgaṇāsthānāni jñeyāni| gatīndriyakāyayogavedakaṣāyajñānasaṃyamadarśanaleśyābhanyasamyaktvasaṃjñāhārakā iti|
35. tatra satprarūpaṇā dvividhā sāmānyena viśeṣeṇa ca | sāmānyena asti mithyādṛṣṭiḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭirityevamādi | viśeṣaṇa gatyanuvādena narakagatau sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu ādyāni catvāri guṇasthānāni santi | tiryaggatau tānyeva saṃyatāsaṃyatasthānādhikāni santi| manuṣyagato caturdaśāpi santi | devagatau nārakavat | indriyānuvādena ekendriyādiṣu caturindriyaparyanteṣu ekameva mithyādṛṣṭisthānam | pañcendriyeṣu caturdaśāpi santi | kāyānuvādena pṛthivīkāyādi vanaspatikāyānteṣu ekameva mithyādṛṣṭisthānam | trasakāyeṣu caturdaśāpi santi | yogānuvādena triṣu yogeṣu trayodaśa guṇasthānāni bhavanti | tataḥ paraṃ ayogakevalī | vedānuvādena triṣu vedeṣu mithyādṛṣṭayādyanivṛttivistārarucivāle hote haiṃ aura dūsare śiṣya na to atisaṃkṣepa kathana karanese samajhate haiṃ aura na ati vistṛta kathana karanese samajhate haiṃ| kintu sajjanoṃkā prayāsa saba jīvoṃ kā upakāra karanā hai, isalie yahā~ alagase jñānake upāyake bhedoṃkā nirdeśa kiyā hai| anyathā 'pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ' itanese hī kāma cala jātā, anya upāyoṃkā grahaṇa karanā niṣphala hotā|
$ 34. aba jīva dravyakī apekṣā 'sat' ādi anuyogadvāroṃkā kathana karate haiṃ yathājīva caudaha guṇasthānoṃmeṃ sthita haiṃ| mithyādṛṣṭi, sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi, samyagmithyādṛṣṭi, asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi, saṃyatāsaṃyata, pramattasaṃyata, apramattasaṃyata, apūrvakaraṇa guṇasthānavartī upaśamaka aura kṣapaka, anivṛttibādarasāmparāya guṇasthānavartī upaśamaka aura kṣapaka, sūkṣmasāmparāya guṇasthānavartī upaśamaka aura kṣapaka, upaśāntakaṣāya vītarāga chadmastha, kṣīṇakaṣāya vītarāga chadmastha, sayogakevalī aura ayogakevalī| ina caudaha jīvasamāsoṃke nirūpaṇa karaneke lie caudaha mārgaṇāsthāna jānane cāhie| yathā-gati, indriya, kāya, yoga, beda, kaṣāya, jñāna, saṃyama, darśana, leśyā, bhalya, samyaktva, saṃjñā aura āhāraka|

$ 38. saṃyama mārgaṇāke anuvādase pramattasaṃyatase kara ayogakevalī guṇasthāna taka saṃyata jīva hote haiṃ | sāmāyika saṃyata aura chedopasthāpanaśuddhisaṃyata jīva pramattasaṃyatase lekara anivṛtti guṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ| parihāraviśuddhisaṃyata jīva pramattasaṃyata aura apramattasaṃyata hote haiṃ| sūkṣmasāmparāyaśaddhisaṃyata jīva eka sūkṣmasāmparāya guṇasthānameṃ hote haiṃ| yathākhyāta vihāra śaddhisaṃyata jīva upaśāntakaṣāya gaṇasthānase lekara ayogakevalī gūṇasthāna taka hote haiṃ| saṃyatāsaṃyata jīva eka sayatāsayata guṇasthānameṃ hote haiṃ| asaṃyata jīva prārambhake cāra guṇasthānoṃmeṃ hote haiṃ|
39. darśana mārgaṇāke anuvādase cakṣudarśana aura acakṣudarśana meṃ mithyādṛṣṭise lekara kṣīṇakaṣāya taka bāraha guṇasthāna haiṃ | avadhidarśanameṃ asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭise lekara kṣīṇakaṣāya taka nau guṇasthāna haiṃ | kevaladarśanameṃ sayogakevalī aura ayogakevalī ye do guṇasthāna haiṃ|
8 40. leśyā mārgaṇāke anuvādase kṛṣṇa, nīla aura kapota lekhāmeṃ mithyādṛ ṣṭise 1.-valī ca | jñānā-tā. na.| 2. daṣṭiścāsti | samyagmithyādaṣṭe: ṭippaṇakārakābhiprāyeṇa jñātavyama | āmini-na.|

- 118846] - prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
[25 tisṛṇāṃ koṭīnāmamupari navānāmayaḥ | apramattasaṃyatāḥ saṃkhyeyāḥ | catvāra upaśamakāḥ praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā | utkarveṇa catuḥpañcāśat | svakālena samuditāḥ saṃkhyeyāḥ | catvāraḥ kṣapakā ayogakedalinaśca praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā | utkarṣeṇāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥ| svakālena samuditāḥ saṃkhyeyāḥ | sayogakevalinaḥ praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā| utkarṣeṇāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥ| svakālena samuditāḥ śatasahasrapayavatvasaṃkhyāḥ| .
846. viśeṣeṇa gatyanuvādena narakagato prathamāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ nārakā mithyādṛṣṭayo'saṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeya bhāgapramitāḥ | dvitīyādiṣvā saptamyā mithyādṛṣṭayaḥ śreṇyasaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ | sa cāṃsaṃspeyabhāgaḥ asaṃkhyegā yojana koṭīkoṭyaḥ | sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭayaḥ samyahamiyādṛṣṭayo'sayasasamyagdṛyaśva palyāpanāsaṃsthevabhāgapramitāḥ|tiryaggatau tiraścāṃmadhye mithyādṛṣṭayo'nantānantāḥ| sāsādanasamyādṛṣṭyādayaḥ saṃyatāsaṃyatāntāḥ palyopamā saṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ| manuṣyagato manuṣyā mithyādṛṣṭayaḥ śregyasaṃkhya bhāgamamitāḥ | sa cāsaṃkhoyabhāgaḥ asaṃkhyeyā yojanahai | isase tīna se ūpara aura nauke nīce madhyakī kisī saṃkhyākā bodha hotā hai| apramattasaṃyata jīva saṃkhyāta haiṃ| cāroṃ upaśamaka guṇasthānavāle jīva praveśakī apekṣā eka, do yā tīna haiṃ, utkṛṣṭarūpase cauvana haiṃ aura apane kālake dvārā saṃcita hue ukta jīva saṃkhyāta haiṃ| cāroṃkṣapaka aura ayogakevalī praveśakī apekṣā eka, do yā tīna haiṃ, utkṛṣṭarūpase ekasau āṭha haiṃ aura apane kālake dvārā saṃcita hue ukta jīva saṃkhyāta haiṃ| sayogakevalī jīva praveśakī apekṣā eka, do yā tīna haiṃ, utkṛṣṭarūpase ekasau āṭha haiṃ aura apane kālake dvārā saṃcita hue ukta jīva lākhapṛthaktva haiṃ|
846. viśeṣakī apekṣā gati mārgaṇāke anuvādase narakagatimeṃ pahalī pṛthivīmeṃ mithyādaṣṭi nārakī asaṃkhyāta jagaśreṇīpramāṇa haiṃ jo jagaśreṇiyā~ jagapratarake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa haiṃ| dūsarī saba pṛthiviyoṃmeṃ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭi, samyagmithyādṛṣṭi aura asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭi nārakī patyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa haiṃ | tiryaṃcagatimeṃ mithyādṛṣṭi tiryaṃca anantānanta haiṃ| sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭise lekara saṃyatāsaṃyata taka pratyeka guṇasthānavāle tiryaca palyopamake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa haiṃ | manuṣyagatimeṃ mithyādṛṣṭi manuṣyajaga śreṇīke asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa haiṃ, jo jagaśreṇīkā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga asaṃkhyātakoḍa़ākoḍa़ī yojana pramāṇa hai| sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭise. lekara saṃyatāsaṃyata taka pratyeka guṇasthānavāle manuṣya saṃkhyāta haiṃ| pramattasaṃyata ādi manuṣyoṃkī vahī saṃkhyā hai jo sāmānyase kaha āye haiṃ | devagatimeṃ mithyādṛṣṭi deva asaṃkhyāta jagaśreṇīpramāṇa' 1. tiraścāṃ mithyā—mu | 2. sāta rāju lambī aura eka pradeśapramāṇa cauḍa़ī ākāśa pradeśa-paṃktiko jagaśreṇi kahate haiṃ | aisī jagapratarake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa jagaśreṇiyoṃmeṃ jitane pradeśa hote haiṃ utane prathama narakake mithyādṛṣṭi nārakī haiṃ yaha ukta kathanakā tātparya hai| 3. jagaśreṇike vargako jagapratara kahate haiṃ| 4. jagaśreṇi meṃ aise asaṃkhyātakā bhāga do jisase asaṃkhyāta yojana koṭākoṭi pramāṇa ākāśa pradeśa prāpta hoṃ, itanī dūsare ādi pratyeka 861. viśeṣakī apekṣā gati mārgaṇāke anuvādase narakagatimeṃ saba pṛthiviyoṃ meṃ nārakiyoṃkā cāra guṇasthānoṃmeṃ lokakā asaṃkhyātavāṃ bhāga kṣetra hai| tiryaṃcagatimeṃ mithyādṛṣṭi guṇasthānase lekara saṃyatāsaṃyata taka pratyeka guṇasthānavāle tiryaṃcoṃkā kṣetra sāmānyavat hai | arthāt mithyādṛṣṭi tiyaṃcoṃkā saba loka kṣetra hai aura śeṣa tiryaṃcoṃkā lokakā asaṃkhyātavāṃ bhāga kṣetra hai| manuṣyagatimeṃ mithyādṛṣṭise lekara ayogakevalī taka pratyeka guṇasthānavāle manuṣyoṃkā kṣetra lokakā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga hai | sayogakevaliyoṃkā sāmānyavat kṣetra hai| devagatimeṃ saba devoṃkā cāra guṇasthānoṃ meṃ lokakā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga kṣetra hai|

1. antarmuhūrta kama | itanī viśeṣatā hai ki prārambhake chaha narakoṃmeṃ mithyātvake sātha utpanna karāve phira antarmuhūrta bāda samyaktvako utpanna karākara jīvana bhara samyaktvake sātha rakhakara utkṛṣṭa kāla prāpta kare | parantu sātaveṃ narakameṃ praveśa aura nirgama donoṃ hī midhyātvake sātha karāve | 2. yahā~ asaṃkhyātase āvalikā asaṃkhyātavā~ bhāga liyā gayā hai| 3. yahā~ pūrvakoṭi pṛthaktvase saiṃtālīsa pūrvakoṭiyoṃ kā grahaṇa kiyā hai | yadyapi pṛthaktva yaha tīnase ūpara aura nause nīcekī saṃkhyākā dyotaka hai tathāpi yahā~ bāhulyakī apekṣā pṛthaktva padase saṃtālīsakā grahaṇa kiyā hai| 4. yahā~ sādhika padase kucha kama pūrvakoṭikā tribhāga liyā gayā hai | udāharaṇārtha – eka pūrvakoṭike āyuvāle jisa manuṣyane tribhāgameṃ manuṣyāyukā bandha kiyā | phira antamuhūrta meṃ samyaktvapūrvaka kṣāyikasamyagdarśanako prāpta kiyā aura āyuke antameṃ marakara tīna palyakī āyuke sātha uttama bhogabhūmimeṃ paidā huā usake avirata samyagdṛṣṭikā utkṛṣṭa kāla prāpta hotā hai |

8165. "pramāṇanayeradhigamaḥ" ityuktam | pramāṇaṃ ca keṣāṃcit jñānamabhimatam | keṣāṃcit
vālā honese yā parimita viṣayavālā honese avadhi kahalātā hai | mana:paryayakā vyutpattilabhya artha = dūsareke manogata arthako mana kahate haiṃ | sambandhase usakā paryayaṇa arthāt parigamana karanevālā jñāna mana:paryaya kahalātā hai| śaṃkā- mana paryaya jñānakā isa prakāra lakṣaṇa karane para use matijñānakā prasaṃga prāpta hotā hai ? samādhāna - nahīṃ, kyoṃki mana:paryayajñānameṃ manakī apekṣāmātra hai | yadyapi vaha kevala baḍha़ī huī kṣayopaśama śaktise apanā kāma karatā hai to bhī kevala sva aura parake manakī apekṣā usakā vyavahāra kiyā jātā hai | yathā, 'ākāśa meṃ candramā dekho' yahā~ ākāśakī apekṣāmātra honese aisā vyavahāra kiyā gayā hai | kevalakā vyutpattilabhya artha = arthījana jisake lie bāhya aura ābhyantara tapake dvārā mārgakā kevana arthāt sevana karate haiṃ vaha kevala - jñāna kahalātā hai | athavā kevala śabda asahāyavācī hai, isalie asahāya jñānako kevalajñāna kahate haiṃ | kevalajñānakī prāpti antameṃ hotī hai isalie sūtra meṃ usakā pāṭha sabake anta meṃ rakhā hai | usake samīpakā hone se usake samīpa meṃ mana:paryayakā grahaṇa kiyā hai| śaṃkā- mana:paryaya kevalajñānake samīpakā kyoṃ hai ? samādhāna - kyoṃki ina donoṃkā saṃyama hī eka ādhāra hai, ataeva mana:paryaya kevalajñānake samīpakā hai | avadhijñāna mana:paryayajñānase dūra hai, isalie usakā mana:paryayajñānake pahale pāṭha rakhā hai | śaṃkā - mana:paryayajñānase avadhijñānako dūrakā kyoṃ kahā ? samādhāna kyoṃki avadhijñāna mana:paryayajñānase atyanta dūra hai | pratyakṣase parokṣakā pahale kathana kiyā, kyoṃki vaha sugama hai| cūṃki mati śrutapaddhati śruta, paricita aura anubhūta honese prāyaḥ saba prāṇiyoṃke dvārā prāpta karane yogya hai ataḥ vaha sugama hai | isa prakāra yaha pā~ca prakārakā jñāna hai | isake bheda ādi āge kaheṃge |

ye aise vicāraṇīya praśna haiṃ jinakā prakṛtameṃ samādhāna karanā āvaśyaka hai| bāta yaha hai ki jaina paramparāmeṃ dravya āgama śrutakī pradhānatā sadāse calī ā rahī hai, isalie sūtrakārane śrutajñānake nirūpaṇake samaya usakā pramukhatāse nirdeśa kiyā hai| para isakā yaha tātparya nahīṃ ki śrutajñāna dravya āgama śrutake jñāna taka hī sīmita hai| matike sivā matipūrvaka honevāle anya anumāna ādi saba parokṣa jñānākā antabhāva śrutajñānameṃ hī hotā hai, kyoṃki ina jñānoṃmeṃ hetu ādikā pratyakṣa jñāna ādi hone para hī ina jñānoṃkī pravṛtti hotī hai| udāharaṇārtha, netra indriyase dhamakā jñāna hotā hai | anantara vyāptikā smaraṇa hotā hai taba jākara 'yahā~ agni honī cāhie' yaha anumāna hotā hai| kahīṃ-kahīṃ matijñānameṃ bhī inake antarbhāvakā nirdeśa milatā hai para vaha kāraṇarūpase hī jānanā cāhie | matijñāna śrutajñānako utpattimeṃ nimitta hai, isalie kāraṇameṃ kāryakā upacāra karake kahīṃ-kahīṃ anumāna ādikā bhī matijñānarūpase nirdeśa kiyā jātā hai| eka bāta aura vicāraṇīya hai, vaha yaha ki yaha śrutajñānakā prakaraṇa hai dravyaśrutakā nahīṃ, isalie yahā~ sūtrakārane śrutajñānake bheda na dikhalākara dravyaśrutake bheda kyoṃ dikhalāye ? uttara yaha hai ki śrutajñānāvaraṇa karmake kṣayopaśamakā aura dravyaśrutakā anyonya sambandha hai | kṣayopaśamake anusāra honevāle śrutajñānako dhyānameṃ rakhakara hī dravyaśrutakā vibhāga kiyā gayā hai | yahī kāraṇa hai ki yahā~ śrutajñānakā prakaraṇa hote hue bhī dravyaśrutake bheda gināye gaye haiṃ| isa bātakī viśeṣa jānakārīke lie gommaṭasāra jīvakāṇḍameṃ nirdiṣṭa jñānamārgaṇā draṣṭavya hai|

8 215. avadhijñānāvaraṇa karmake deśaghātī spardhakoṃkā udaya rahate hue sarvaghāti spardhakoṃkā udayābhāvī kṣaya aura anudaya prāpta inhīṃkā sadavasthārūpa upaśama ina donoṃke nimittase jo hotā hai vaha kṣayopaśamanimittaka avadhijñāna hai | yaha śeṣa jīvoṃke jānanā cāhie| śaṃkāśeṣa kauna haiṃ ? samādhāna-manuṣya aura niryaca | unameṃ bhī jinake sāmarthya hai unhīṃke jānanā cāhie | asaṃjñī aura aparyāptakoṃke yaha sāmarthya nahīṃ hai | saṃjñī aura paryāptakoṃmeṃ bhī sabake yaha sāmarthya nahīṃ hotī | śaṃkā-to phira kinake hotī hai ? samādhāna-yathokta samyagdarśana ādi nimittoṃke milane para jinake avadhijñānāvaraṇa karma śānta aura kṣīṇa ho gayā hai unake yaha sāmarthya hotī hai | avadhijñāna mātra kṣayopaśamake nimittase hotā hai to bhī sūtrameṃ kṣayopaśama padakā grahaṇa yaha niyama karaneke lie kiyā hai ki ukta jīvoṃke mātra kṣayopaśama nimitta hai bhava nahīṃ| yaha avadhijñāna anugāmī, ananugāmī, vardhamāna, hīyamāna, avasthita aura anavasthitake bhedase chaha prakārakā hai| koī avadhijñāna jaise sūrya kā prakāśa usake sātha jātā hai vaise apane svāmī kā anusaraṇa karatā hai | koī avadhijñāna anusaraṇa nahīṃ karatā,kiṃtu jaise vimukha hue puruṣake praśnake uttarasvarūpa dūsarā puruṣa jo vacana kahatā hai vaha vahīṃ chūṭa jātā hai, vimukha puruṣa use grahaṇa nahīṃ karatā hai vaise hī yaha avadhijñāna bhī vahīṃpara chūṭa jātā hai| koī avadhijñāna jaṃgalake nirmanthanase utpanna haī aura sūkhe pattoṃse upacīyamāna īdhanake samudāyase vṛddhiko prāpta huī agnike samāna samyagdarśanādi guṇoṃkī viśuddhirūpa pariṇāmoṃke sannidhānavaśa jitane parimāṇameṃ utpanna hotā hai usase asaṃkhyāta loka jānane kī yogyatā hone taka baḍha़tā jātā hai| koī avadhijñāna parimita upādānasantativālī agniśikhāke samāna samyagdarśanādi guṇoṃkī hānise hue saṃkleśa pariṇāmoṃke baḍhanese jitane parimāṇameṃ utpanna hotā hai usase mātra aṃgalake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa jānanekī yogyatā hone taka ghaṭatā calā jātā hai| koī avadhijñāna samyagdarśanādi guṇoṃke samānarūpase 1. $ 617. ādāvuddiṣṭasyāsravasya bhedapratipādanārthamāhaindriyakaṣāyāvratakriyāḥ pañcacatuḥpañcapañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyāḥ pūrvasya medāḥ||5||
8618. atra indriyādīnāṃ paṃcādibhiryathāsaṃkhyamabhisaṃbandho veditavyaḥ | indriyāṇi paṃca | viśeṣatā hai? aba isī bāta batalāneke lie āgekā satra kahate haiṃ
kaṣāyasahita aura kaṣāyarahita ātmākā yoga kramase sāmparāyika aura īryāpatha karmake āsravarūpa hai ||4||
8616. svāmīke bhedase āsravameṃ bheda hai| svāmī do prakārake haiṃ-kaṣāyasahita aura kaṣāyarahita | krodhādika kaṣāya kahalāte haiṃ | kaṣāyake samāna honese kaṣāya kahalātā hai| upamārūpa artha kyā hai ? jisa prakāra naiyagrodha ādi kaṣāya śleṣakā kāraṇa hai usī prakāra ātmākā krodhādi rūpa kaṣāya bhī karmoṃ ke śleṣakā kāraṇa hai isalie kaṣāyake samāna yaha kaṣāya hai aisā kahate haiṃ| jisake kaṣāya hai vaha sakaṣāya jīva hai aura jisake kaṣāya nahīṃ hai vaha akaṣāya jīva hai| yahā~ ina donoṃ padoṃkā pahale 'sakaṣāyaśca akaṣāyaśceti sakaṣāyākaṣāyau' isa prakāra dvandva samāsa karake anantara svāmitva dikhalāneke lie ṣaṣṭhīkā dvivacana diyā hai| samparāya saṃsārakā paryāyavācī hai | jo karma saṃsārakā prayojaka hai vaha sāmparāyika karma hai| īryākī vyutpatti 'īraṇaṃ' hogī| yogakā artha gati hai| jo karma isake dvārā prāpta hotā hai vaha īryāpatha karma hai| yahā~ ina donoṃ padoṃkā pahale ‘sāmparāyikaṃ ca īryāpathaṃ ca sāmparāyikeryāpathe' isa prakāra dvandva samāsa karake tadanantara sambandha dikhalāneke lie ṣaṣṭhīkā dvivacana diyā hai| sakaṣāyake sātha sāmparāyika śabdakā aura akaṣāyake sātha īryāpatha śabdakā yathākrama sambandha hai | jisase yaha artha huā ki mithyādṛṣṭi ādi kaṣāyasahita jīvake sāmparāyika karmakā āsrava hotā hai | tathā upaśānta kaṣāya ādi kaṣāya rahita jīvake īryāpatha karmakā āsrava hotā hai|
8617. ādimeṃ kahe gaye āsravake bheda dikhalāneke lie āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃ
pūrvake arthāt sāmparāyika karmāsravake indriya, kaṣāya, avrata aura kriyārūpa bheva haiṃ jo kramase pā~ca, cāra, pā~ca aura paccīsa haiṃ ||5||

8626. nirvartyata iti nirvartanā niṣpādanā | nikṣipyata iti nikṣepaḥ sthāpanā | saṃyujyate iti saṃyogo miśrīkṛtam | nisṛjyata iti nisargaḥ pravartanam | ete dvayādibhiryathākramamabhisaṃbadhyante-
prayogako apekṣā dikhalāneke lie 'kārita' vacana rakhā hai | tathā prayojakake mānasa pariṇāmako dikhalāneke lie anumata śabda rakhā haiṃ | krodhādi kaṣāyoṃke lakṣaṇa kahe jā cuke haiṃ | jisase eka artha dūsare arthase viśeṣatāko prāpta ho vaha viśeṣa hai | ise pratyeka śabdake sātha joḍa़ lenā cāhie yathā saṃrambhaviśeṣa samārambhaviśeṣa ādi | yahā~ 'bhidyate' yaha vākyaśeṣa hai jisase yaha artha hotā hai ki pahalā jīvādhikaraṇa ina viśeṣatāoṃse bhedako prāpta hotā hai | suc pratyayānta ye cāroṃ 'tīna' ādi śabda kramase sambandhako prāpta hote haiṃ | yathā-saṃrambha, samārambha aura ārambha ye tīna; yoga tīna; kṛta, kārita aura anumata ye tīna aura kaṣāya cāra| inake gaṇanākī punarāvṛtti 'suca' pratyaya-dvārā prakaṭa kī gayī hai | 'ekaśaḥ' yaha vīpsā meṃ nirdeśa hai | tātparya yaha hai ki tīna ādi bhedoṃko pratyekake prati lagā lenā cāhie| jaise krodhakṛtakāyasaṃrambha, mānakṛtakāyasaṃrambha, māyākṛtakāyasaṃrambha, lobhakṛtakāyasaṃrambha, krodhakāritakāyasaṃrambha, mānakāritakāya़saṃrambha, māyākāritakāyasaṃrambha, lobhakāritakāyasaṃrambha, krodhānumatakāyasaṃrambha, mānānumatakāyasaṃrambha, māyānumatakāyasaṃrambha, lobhānumatakāyasaṃrambha| isaprakāra kāyasaṃrambha bāraha prakārakā hai | isīprakāra vacanayoga aura manoyogakī apekṣā saṃrambha bāraha-bāraha prakārakā hai | ye saba milā kara chattīsa bheda hote haiṃ | isī prakāra samārambha aura ārambhake bhī chattīsa - chattīsa bheda hote haiṃ| ye saba mila kara jīvādhikaraṇake 108 bheda hote haiṃ | 'ca' śabda anantānubandhī apratyākhyāna, pratyākhyāna aura saṃjvalanarūpa kaṣāyoṃke avāntara bhedoṃkā samuccaya karaneke lie diyā hai | 8625. aba dūsare ajīvādhikaraṇake bhedoṃkā jñāna karāneke lie āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃ-para arthāt ajīvādhikaraṇa kramase do, cāra, do aura tīna bhedavāle nirvartanā, nikṣepa, saṃyoga aura nisargarūpa hai ||9||

5627. uktaḥ sāmānyena karmāsravabhedaḥ | idānī karmaviśeṣātravabhedo vaktavyaḥ| tasmin vaktavye ādyayonidarśanāvaraṇayorāsravabhedapratipattyarthamāha
tatpradoṣanihnavamātsaryāntarāyāsādanopaghātā jñānadarśanāvaraṇayoḥ ||10||
8628. tattvajñānasya mokṣasādhanasya kīrtane kṛte kasyacidanabhivyāharataḥ aṃtaḥpaiśunyapariṇāmaḥ pradoṣaḥ | kutaścitkāraṇānnāsti na vedmotyādi jñānasya vyapalapanaṃ nihnavaḥ | kutaścitkāraṇād bhāvitamapi vijñānaṃ dānāhamapi yato na dīyate tanmātsaryam | jñānavyavacchedakaraṇamantarāyaḥ| kāyena kramase do ādi śabdoṃke sātha sambandhako prāpta hote haiṃ | yathā-nirvartanā do prakārakī hai| nikṣepa cāra prakārakā hai | saṃyoga do prakārakā hai | nisarga tīna prakārakā hai| ye saba ajīvādhikaraṇake bheda haiṃ | śaṃkā--sūtrameṃ 'para' vacana nirarthaka hai; kyoṃki pichale sūtrameṃ 'ādya' vacana diyā hai jisase yaha jñāta hotā hai ki yaha śeṣake lie hai | samādhāna-anarthaka nahīṃ hai kyoṃki yahā~ 'para' śabdakā anya artha hai jisase yaha jñāta hotā hai ki nirvartanā ādika saṃrambha ādikase anya haiṃ| yadi para śabda na diyā jāya to nirvartanā ādi ātmāke pariṇāma haiṃ aisā ho jānese ye jīvādhikaraṇake bheda samajhe jāyeṃge | nirvartanādhikaraṇa do prakārakā hai—mūlaguṇa nirvartanādhikaraṇa aura uttaraguṇa nirvartanādhikaraṇa | unameṃ-se mūlaguṇa nivartanādhikaraṇa pā~ca prakārakā hai-śarīra, vacana, mana, prāṇa aura apāna | tathā kāṣṭhakarma, pustakarma aura citrakarma ādi uttaraguṇa nirvartanādhikaraṇa haiṃ | nikṣepa cāra prakārakā hai-apratyavekṣitanikṣepādhikaraṇa, duṣpramṛṣṭanikṣepādhikaraṇa, sahasānikṣepādhikaraṇa aura anābhoganikṣepādhikaraṇa | saṃyoga do prakārakā hai-bhaktapānasaṃyogādhikaraṇa aura upakaraṇasaṃyogādhikaraṇa | nisarga tīna prakārakā hai-kāyanisargādhikaraṇa, vacananisargādhikaraṇa aura mananisargādhikaraṇa|
8627. sāmānyase karmāsravake bheda kahe| isa samaya alaga-alaga karmoke āsravake bhedoṃkā kathana karanā cāhie| usameṃ sarvaprathama prārambhake jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇake āsravake bhedoṃkā kathana karaneke lie āgekā sūtra kahate haiṃ
jñāna aura darśanake viṣayameṃ pradoṣa, nihnava, mātsarya, antarāya, āsādana aura upaghāta ye. jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇake āsrava haiṃ ||10||

252] sarvārthasiddhī
[61118 629vācā ca paraprakāśyajñānasya varjanamāsādanam | praśastajñānadūṣaṇamupadhātaḥ | āsāvanameveti cet ? sato jñānasya vinayapradānādiguṇakīrtanānanuṣṭhānamāsādanam | upaghātastu jñānamajñānameveti jñānanāśābhiprāyaḥ | ityanayorayaṃ bhedaḥ | 'tat'śabdena jñānadarśanayoḥ pratinirdeśaḥ kriyate| kathaṃ punaraprakṛtayoranirdiṣṭayostacchabdena parāmarśaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ ? praśnāpekṣayā| jñānadarśanāvaraṇayoḥ ka āsrava iti praśne kṛte tadapekṣayā tacchabdo jñānadarśane pratinirdiśati | etena jñānadarśanavatsu tatsādhaneṣu ca pradoṣādayo yojyāḥ; tannimittatvāt | ta ete jñānadarśanāvaraṇayorāsravahetavaḥ| ekakāraṇasādhyasya kāryasyānekasya darśanāta tulye'pi pradoṣādau jñānarśanāvaraṇāstravasiddhiḥ| athavā viṣayabhedādāsravabhedaḥ | jñānaviṣayāḥ pradoṣādayo jñānāvaraṇasya | darśanaviṣayāḥ pradoṣādayo darśanāvaraṇasyeti|
8629. yathānayoḥ karmaprakṛtyorānavabhedāstathā--- duḥkhaśokatāpākrandanavadhaparidevanānyātmaparobhayasthānyasadvedyasya ||
8630. pīḍālakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmo duḥkham | anugrāhakasaṃbandhavicchede vaiklavyaviśeṣaḥ śokaḥ | parivādādinimittādāvilāntaḥkaraṇasya tīvrānuśayastāpaḥ | paritāpajātāśrupātapracuravipralāpādibhirvyaktakrandanamākrandanam | āyurindriyabalaprāṇaviyogakaraṇaṃ vadhaḥ | saṃkleśapariṇāmāvalambana vene yogya bhī hai to jisa kāraṇase vaha nahīṃ diyā jātā hai vaha mātsarya hai| jñānakā viccheda karanā antarāya haiṃ | dūsarā koī jñānakā prakāśa kara rahā ho taba śarīra yā vacanase usakā niṣedha karanā āsādana hai| praśaṃsanīya jñānameṃ dūṣaṇa lagānā upaghāta hai | śaṃkā–upaghātakā jo lakṣaṇa kiyā hai usase vaha āsādana hī jñāta hotā hai ? samādhāna-praśasta jñānakī vinaya na karanā, usakī acchāīkī praśaṃsā na karanā ādi āsādana hai| parantu jñānako ajñāna samajhakara jñānake nāśakā irādā rakhanā upaghāta hai isa prakāra ina donoṃ meṃ antara hai| satrameṃ 'tat' pada jñāna aura darśanakā nirdeśa karaneke lie diyā hai | śaṃkā–jñāna aura darśana aprakṛta haiṃ, tathā unakā nirdeśa bhī nahīṃ kiyā hai, phira yahā~ 'tat'śabdake dvārā unakā jñāna kaise ho sakatā hai ? samādhānapraśnaikī apekṣā arthāt jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇakā kyā āsrava hai aisā praśna karanepara usakī apekṣā 'tata' śabda jñāna aura darśanakā nirdeśa karatā hai| isase yaha abhiprāya nikalā ki jñāna aura darśanavāloṃke viṣayameṃ tathā unake sādhanoṃke viṣayameṃ pradoṣādikakī yojanā karanī cāhie, kyoṃki ye unake nimittase hote haiṃ | ye pradoṣādika jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇa karmake āsravake kāraṇa haiṃ | eka kāraṇase bhī aneka kārya hote hue dekhe jāte haiṃ, isalie pradoṣādikake eka samāna rahate hue bhī inase jñānāvaraṇa aura darśanāvaraṇa donoṃkā āsrava siddha hotā hai| athavā viṣayake bhedase āsravame bheda hotā hai| jñānasambandhī pradoṣādika jñānāvaraṇake āsrava haiṃ aura darśanasambandhī pradoṣādika darśanāvaraṇake āsrava haiṃ|
8629. jisa prakāra ina donoṃ karmoṃkā āsrava aneka prakārakā hai usī prakāra
apanemeṃ, dūsaremeṃ yā donoṃmeṃ vidyamāna duḥkha, śoka, tāpa, ākrandana, vadha aura paridevana ye asātā vedanīya karmake āsrava haiṃ ||1||
8630. pīḍa़ārūpa ātmākā pariṇāma duḥkha hai | upakāra karanevālekā sambandha ṭūṭa jānepara jo vikalatā hotī hai vaha śoka hai | apavāda ādike nimittase manake khinna honepara jo tīvra anuśaya-saṃtāpa hotā hai vaha tāpa hai | paritāpake kāraṇa jo ā~sū giraneke sātha vilāpa ādi 1. -lambanaṃ svaparā- ā., di. 1, di. 2|

[253 guṇasmaraṇānukīrtanapūrvakaṃ svaparānugrahābhilāṣaviṣayamanukampāpracuraṃ rodanaṃ paridevanam | nanu ca śokādīnāṃ duḥkhaviśeṣatvād duḥkhagrahaṇamevāstu ? satyamevam ; tathāpi katipayaviśeṣapratipādanena duḥkhajātya'nuvidhānaṃ kriyate | yathā gaurityukte anirmāte viśeṣe tatpratipādanārthaṃ khaṇḍamuṇḍakṛṣṇaśuklājupādānaṃ kriyate tathā duḥkhaviṣayāsravāsaṃkhyeyalokabhedasaṃbhavād duḥkhamityukte viśeṣānirjānātkatipayaviśeṣanirdeśena tadviśeṣapratipattiḥ kriyate| tānyetāni duḥkhādīni 'krodhādyāveśādātmasthāni bhavanti parasthānyubhayasthāni ca | etāni sarvāṇyasadvedyāsravakāraṇāni veditavyāni| atra codyate--yadi duḥkhādīnyātmaparobhayasthānyasadvadyāsravanimittāni, kimarthamārhataḥ keśaluñcanānaśanātapasthānādīni duḥkhanimittānyāsthīyante pareṣu ca pratipādyante iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ-antaraṅgakrodhādyāveśapūrvakāṇi duḥkhādīnyasadvedyāsravanimittānoti viśeṣyoktatvāt | yathā kasyacid bhiṣajaḥ paramakaruṇāśasya niḥśalyasya saṃyatasyopari gaṇḍaṃ pāṭayato duḥkhahetutve satyapi na pāpabandho bāhyanimittamātrādeva bhavati | evaṃ saṃsāraviṣayamahāduḥkhādudvignasya bhikṣostannivṛttyupāyaṃ prati samāhitamanaskasya śāstravihite karmaṇi pravartamānasya saṃkleśapariṇāmābhāvād duḥkhanimittatve satyapi na pāpabandhaḥ| uktaṃ ca--
"na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yadvaddhatudṛṣṭaścikitsite| cikitsāyāṃ tu yuktasya syād duḥkhamathavā sukham ||
hotā hai, usase khulakara ronā ākrandana hai | āyu, indriya, bala aura śvāsocchvāsakā judā kara denā vadha hai | saṃkleśarūpa pariṇāmoṃke honepara guṇoṃkā smaraṇa aura praśaṃsā karate hue apane aura
upakārakī abhilāṣāse karuṇājanaka ronā paridevana hai| śaṃkā-śokādika duḥkhake bheda haiṃ, isalie duḥkhakā grahaṇa karanā paryāpta hai ? samādhāna-yaha kahanā sahī hai to bhī yahā~ kucha bhedoṃkā kathana karake duḥkhakī jātiyā~ dikhalāyī haiṃ | jaise gau aisā kahanepara avāntara bhedoṃkā jñāna nahīṃ hotā, isalie khāṃḍī, muḍī, kālī, sapheda ādi viśeṣaṇa diye jāte haiṃ usī prakāra duḥkhaviṣayaka āsrava asaṃkhyāta lokapramāṇa saṃbhava haiṃ | parantu duḥkha itanā kahanepara saba bhedoṃkā jñāna nahīṃ hotā ataeva kucha bhedoṃkā ullekha karake unako pṛthaka-pṛthak jāna liyā jātā hai| krodhādikake āveśavaśa ye duḥkhādika kabhī apanemeṃ hote haiṃ, kabhī dūsaroṃmeṃ hote haiṃ aura kabhī donoṃmeṃ hote haiṃ | ye saba asātā vedanīyake āsravake kāraṇa jānane cāhie | śaṃkā-yadi apanemeṃ, parameṃ yā donoṃmeṃ sthita duḥkhādika asātāvedanīyake āsravake kāraṇa haiṃ to arihaṃtake matako mānanevāle manuṣya duḥkhako paidā karanevāle keśaloṃca, anaśana aura ātapasthāna (ātāpanayoga) ādimeṃ kyoṃ viśvāsa karate haiṃ aura dūsaroṃko inakā upadeśa kyoṃ dete haiṃ ? samādhāna—yaha koī doṣa nahīṃ hai; kyoṃki antaraṃgameṃ krodhādikake āveśase jo duḥkhādika paidā hote haiṃ ve asātāvedanīyake āsravake kāraṇa haiṃ itanā yahā~ viśeṣa kahā hai | jaise atyanta dayālu kisī vaidyake phoḍa़ekī cīra-phāḍa़ aura marahamapaṭṭī karate samaya niḥśalya saṃyatako duḥkha denemeṃ nimitta honepara bhī kevala bāhya nimitta mātrase pāpabandha nahīṃ hotā usī prakāra jo bhikṣu saṃsāra-sambandhī duḥkhase udvigna hai aura jisakā mana usake dūra karaneke upāyoṃmeṃ lagā huā hai usake śāstravihita karmameṃ pravṛtti karate samaya saṃkleśarūpa pariṇāmoṃke nahīṃ honese pāpabandha nahīṃ hotā| kahā bhī hai-"jisa prakāra cikitsāke sādhana na svayaṃ duḥkharūpa dekhe jāte haiṃ aura na sukharūpa, kintu jo cikitsāmeṃ 1. --jātyantaravidhā-- mu.| 2. krodhāveśā- mu.|

tesiṃ ce uppattī hiṃseti jiṇehi ṇiddiṭṭhā |" ki ca maraṇasyāniṣṭatvādyathā vaṇijo vividhapaṇyadānādānasaṃcayaparasya svagahavināśo'niṣṭaḥ| tadvināśakāraṇe ca kutaścidupasthite yathāśakti pariharati | duṣparihāre ca paṇyavināśo yathā na. bhavati tathā yatate | evaṃ gṛhastho'pi vrataśīlapaṇyasaṃcaye pravartamānaḥ tadāśrayasya na pātamabhivāṃchati| kaṣāyoṃkā, uttarottara kāya aura kaṣāyako puṣṭa karanevāle kāraṇoṃko ghaṭāte hue, bhale prakārase lekhana karanā arthāt kṛṣa karanā sallekhanā hai | maraṇake antameṃ hone vālī isa sallekhanāko prītipūrvaka sevana karanevālā gṛhastha hotā hai yaha isa sūtrakā tātparya hai| śaṃkā--sahaja tarīkaise arthakā spaṣṭīkaraṇa ho isake lie sūtrameṃ 'joṣitā' isake sthānameṃ 'sevitā' kahanā ṭhīka hai| samādhāna-nahīṃ; kyoṃki 'joṣitā' kriyāke rakhanese usase artha-viśeṣa dhvanita ho jātā hai| yahā~ kevala 'sevana karanā' artha nahīṃ liyā gayā hai kintu prīti rūpa artha bhī liyā gayā hai, kyoṃki prītike na rahane para balapūrvaka sallekhanā nahīṃ karāyī jātī | kintu prītike rahane para jīva svayaṃ ho sallekhanā karatā hai| tātparya yaha hai ki 'prītipūrvaka sevana karanā' yaha artha 'joṣitā' kriyāse nikala ātā hai 'sevitā' se nahīṃ, ata: sūtrameṃ 'joṣitā' kriyā rakhī hai| śaṃkā-cū ki sallekhanāmeṃ apane abhiprāyase āyu ādikā tyāga kiyā jātā hai, isalie yaha ātmaghāta huā ? samādhāna--yaha koī doṣa nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki sallekhanāmeṃ pramādakā abhāva | 'pramattayogase prāṇoṃkā vadha karanā hiṃsā hai' yaha pahale kahā jā cukā hai| parantu isake pramāda nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki isake rāgādika nahīṃ pāye jāte| rāga, dveṣa aura mohase yukta hokara jo viṣa aura śastra ādi upakaraṇoṃkā prayoga karake unase apanā ghāta karatā hai use ātmaghātakā doṣa prāpta hotā hai| parantu sallekhanāko prāpta hue jīvake rāgādika to haiṃ nahīṃ, isalie ise ātmaghātakā doṣa nahīṃ prāpta hotā | kahā bhī hai. "śāstrameṃ yaha upadeśa hai ki rāgādikā nahīṃ utpanna honā ahiṃsā hai| tathā jinadevane unakī utpattiko hiṃsā kahā hai ||" . dūsare, maraṇa kisī ko bhī iṣṭa nahīṃ hai| jaise nānā prakārakī vikraya vastuoṃke dena, lena aura saṃcayameṃ lage hue kisī vyāpārīko apane gharakā nāśa honā iṣṭa nahīṃ hai | phira bhī paristhitivaśa usake vināśake kāraṇa ā upasthita hoṃ to yathāśakti vaha unako dūra karatā hai | itane para bhī yadi ve dūra na ho sakeṃ to jisase vikraya vastuoṃkā nāśa na ho aisā prayatna karatā hai usī prakāra paṇyasthānīya vrata aura śīlake saṃcayameṃ juṭā huā gṛhastha bhī unake ādhārabhūta āyu ādikā patana nahīṃ cāhatā | yadā kadācit unake vināśake kāraṇa utpanna ho jāya to jisase apane guṇomeṃ bādhā nahīṃ paḍa़e isa prakāra unako dūra karanekā prayatna karatā hai| itane para bhī yadi ve dūra 1. ti bhāsidaṃ sa- mu.| 2. -śakti ca pari- mu.|

-81238778] aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
[313 ca' iti vakṣyate tataśca bhavati anyataśceti sūtrārtho yojitaḥ | kimarthamiha nirjarānirdeśaḥ kriyate, saṃvarātparā nirdeṣṭavyā uddeśavat ? laghvarthamiha vacanam | tatra hi pāṭhe 'vipāko'nubhavaḥ' iti punaranuvādaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt | kisalie kiyā hai, kyoṃki uddeśyake anusāra usakā saṃvarake bāda ullekha karanā ṭhīka hotā ? samādhāna-thoḍa़emeṃ bodha karāneke lie yahā~ nirjarākā ullekha kiyā hai | saṃvarake bāda pāṭha dene para 'vipāko'nubhavaḥ' isakā phirase anuvāda karanā paḍa़tā|
viśeṣārtha--anubhava, anubhāga yā phaladānaśakti inakā eka hī artha hai | karmakā bandha hote samaya jisa karmakī jo prakuti hotī hai usake anurūpa use phaladānaśakti prāpta hotī hai| udāharaṇārtha-jñānāvaraṇakī jñānako āvṛta karanekī prakṛti hai, isalie ise isīke anurūpa phaladāna śakti prāpta hotī hai| prakṛtikā artha svabhāva hai aura anubhavakā artha hai usa svabhāvake anurūpa use bhoganā| sādhāraṇata: yahā~ yaha kahā jā sakatā hai ki yadi prakṛti aura anubhavakā yahī artha hai to inheṃ alaga-alaga mānanā ucita nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki jisa karmakī jaisī prakṛti hogī usake anurūpa usakā bhoga sutarāṃ siddha hai| isalie prakṛtibandha aura anubhavabandha ye do svatantra siddha nahīṃ hote, kintu anubhavabandhakā antarbhāva prakṛtibandhameṃ hī ho jātā hai | yadi kahā jāya ki jñānāvaraṇa ādi rūpase karmakī prakṛti phaladānaśaktike nimittase hotī hai, isalie prakṛtibandhameṃ anubhavabandhakā antarbhāva nahīṃ kiyā jā sakatā so isakā yaha samādhāna hai ki jabaki prakṛtibandhakā kāraṇa yoga hai aura anubhavabandhakī hīnādhikatākā kāraṇa kaṣāya hai taba phira phaladāna śaktike nimittase karmakī prakṛti banatī hai yaha kaise mānā jā sakatā hai| thoḍa़ī derako yaha māna bhī liyā jāya taba bhī yaha praśna khaḍa़ā rahatā hai ki prakṛtibandha aura anubhavabandhako alaga alaga kyoṃ mānā gayā hai aura unake alaga alaga mānaneke yoga aura kaṣāya do svatantra kāraṇa kyoṃ batalāye gaye haiṃ| sūtrakārane bandhake cāra bheda karake bhī vipāka arthāt karmabhogako anubhava kahā hai aura use prakṛtike anurūpa batalāyā hai | isase to yahī siddha hotā hai ki vastutaḥ ye do nahīṃ haiṃ, kintu bandha samayakī apekṣā jisakā nāma prakṛti hai udayakāla kī apekṣā use hī anubhava kahate haiṃ ? samādhāna yaha hai ki karmabandhake samaya karmakā vividharūpase vibhāga yogake nimittase hī hotā hai aura vibhāgako prāpta hue karmomeṃ hīnādhika phaladānaśakti kā prāpta honā kaṣāyake nimittase hotā hai, isalie ye donoṃ svatantra māne gaye haiṃ| yadyapi yaha ṭhīka hai ki binā śaktike kisī karmakī prakṛti nahīṃ bana sakatī| svatantra prakati kahanese usakī śaktikā bodha ho hī jātā hai, phira bhī aisī śaktikī eka sīmā hotī hai| usakā ullaṃghana kara jo nyūnādhika śakti pāyo jātī hai usīkā bodha karānā anubhāgabandhakā kāma hai| udāharaṇārtha gyārahaveṃ, bārahaveṃ aura terahaveṃ guṇasthānameṃ sātāvedanīyakā prakṛtibandha hotā hai aura yaha prakṛtibandha eka niyata maryādāmeṃ anubhāgako liye hī hotā hai, phira bhī yahā~ anubhāgabandhakā niṣedha kiyā gayā hai so isakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki jo anubhāga sakaṣāya avasthāmeṃ sātāvedanīyakā prāpta hotā thā vaha yahā~ prāpta nahīṃ hotā hai| sakaṣāya avasthāmeṃ prāpta honevāle jaghanya anubhāgase bhī yaha anantaveṃ bhāgamātra hotā hai| itanā kama anubhāga sakaṣāya avasthāmeṃ nahīṃ prāpta ho sakatā| isase prakṛtibandhase anubhāgabandhake alaga kahanekī upayogitā siddha ho jātī hai| tātparya yaha hai ki prakṛtibandhameṃ karmabheda ko svīkāra karake bhī nyūnādhika phaladāna śakti nahīṃ svīkāra kī gayī hai, kintu anubhāgabandhameṃ isakā aura isake kāraṇakā svatantra rūpase vicāra kiyā jātā hai, isalie prakṛtibandha aura usakā kāraṇa svatantra hai tathā anubhāgabandha aura

[315 nāmapratyayāḥ sarvato yogaviśeṣātsūkṣmaikakṣetrāvagāhasthitāḥ
sarvātmapradeśeṣvanantānantapradeśāḥ ||24|| 8780. nāmnaḥ pratyayā nāmapratyayāḥ 'nāma' iti sarvāḥ karmaprakṛtayo'bhidhīyante ; 'sa yathānāma' iti vacanāt | anena hetubhāva uktaḥ | sarveṣu bhaveṣu sarvataḥ 'dṛśyante anyato'pi' iti tasi kṛte sarvataḥ | anena kālopādānaṃ iti kṛtam | ekaikasya hi jīvasyātikrāntā anantā bhavā āgāminaḥ saṃkhyeyā asaṃkhyeyā anantānantā vā bhavantīti | yogaviśeṣānimittātkarmabhāvena pudgalā ādīyanta iti nimittaviśeṣanirdeśaḥ kṛto bhavati | 'sūkṣma' ādigrahaṇaṃ karmagrahaṇayogyapudgalasvabhāvānuvartanārtham, grahaṇayogyāḥ pudgalāḥ sūkṣmā na sthūlā iti | 'ekakṣetrāvagāha'vacanaṃ kṣetrāntaranivṛttyartham | "sthitāḥ' iti vacanaṃ kriyāntaranivṛttyartham, sthitā na gacchanta iti | 'sarvātmapradeśeṣu' iti vacanamādhāranirdeśārtha naikapradeśādiṣu karmapradeśā dartante | kva tahi ? ūrdhvamastiryak ca sarveṣvātmapradeśeṣu vyāpya sthitā iti | 'anantānantapradeśa'vacanaṃ parimāṇāntaravyapohārtham, na saṃkhyeyā na cāsaṃkhyeyā nāpyanantā iti | te khalu pudgalaskandhā abhavyānantaguṇāḥ siddhānantabhāgapramitapradeśā ghanāmulasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgakṣetrāvagāhina ekadvitricatuḥsaṃkhyeyasamayasthitikāḥ pañcavarṇapañcarasa-dvigandha-cataḥsparśasvabhāvā aṣṭavidhakarmaprakṛtiyogyā yogavaśādātmanātmasākriyante| iti pradeśa-bandhaḥ samāsato veditavyaḥ |
karma prakṛtiyoṃke kāraṇabhūta prati samaya yogaviśeṣase sūkṣma, ekakṣetrāvagāhī aura sthita anantānanta pudgala paramāṇu saba ātmapradeśoṃmeṃ (sambandhako prāpta) hote haiṃ ||24||
8780. nāmapratyayā:-nāmake kāraṇabhūta karmaparamāṇu nāmapratyaya kahalāte haiṃ| 'nāma' isa pada dvārā saba karmaprakṛtiyā~ kahī jātī haiṃ | jisakī puṣṭi ‘sa yathānāma' isa sūtravacanase hotī hai| isa padadvārā hetukā kathana kiyā gayā hai| sarvataḥ-pradeśabandha saba bhavoṃmeṃ hotā hai| 'sarveṣu bhateṣu iti sarvata:' yaha isakī vyutpatti hai | sarva śabdase 'dṛśyante'nyato'pi' isa sūtra dvārā tasi pratyaya karanepara sarvata: pada banatā hai | isa padadvārā kālakā grahaṇa kiyā gayā hai| eka-eka jīvake vyatīta hae anantānanta bhava hote haiṃ aura āgāmī saṃkhyāta, asaṃkhyāta va anantānanta bhava hote haiṃ| yogaviśeṣāta-yogaviśeṣarūpa nimittase karmarūpa pūdagala grahaṇa kiye jāte haiṃ| isa pada dvārā nimittaviśeṣakā nirdeśa kiyā gayā hai | karmarūpase grahaṇa yogya pudgaloṃkā svabhāva dikhalāneke lie sūkṣma ādi padakā grahaṇa kiyā hai | grahaṇayogya pudgala sūkṣma hote haiṃ sthūla nahīṃ hote| kṣetrāntarakā nirākaraṇa karane ke lie 'ekakṣetrāvagāha' vacana diyā hai| kriyāntarakī nivattike lie 'sthitā:' vacana diyā hai | grahaṇayogya pudgala sthita hote haiṃ gamana karate hue nahīṃ| ādhāranirdeśa karaneke lie 'sarvātmapradeśeṣu' vacana diyā hai | ekapradeśa ādimeṃ karmapradeśa nahīṃ rahate | phira kahā~ rahate haiṃ ? ūpara, nīce, tirache saba ātmapradeśoṃmeṃ vyāpta hokara sthita hote haiṃ| dūsare parimāṇakā vāraṇa karaneke lie anantānantapradeśa bacana diyā hai| ye na saṃkhyāta hote haiṃ, na asaṃkhyāta hote haiṃ aura na ananta hote haiṃ | abhavyoṃse anantaguṇe aura siddhoṃke anantaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa saṃkhyāvāle, ghanāṃgulake asaṃkhyātaveṃ bhāgapramāṇa kṣetrakī avagāhanāvāle, eka, do, tīna, cāra, saṃkhyāta aura asaṃkhyāta samayakī sthitivāle tathā pā~ca varṇa, pā~ca rasa, do gandha aura cāra sparśavāle ve āṭha prakārakī karmaprakṛtiyoṃke yogya karmaskandha yogaviśeṣase ātmādvārā ātmasāt kiye jāte haiṃ| isa prakāra saṃkṣepameṃ pradeśabandha jānanā cāhie| 1. --krāntā anantātantā bhavāḥ tā., nā.| 2. --asaṃkhyeyā anantā vā tā., nā.| 3. vaśādātmasā- ā,|

8797. śaṃkā-yaha kisalie kahā hai ? samādhāna-saṃvarakā prathama kāraṇa pravattikā nigraha karane ke lie kahā hai| jo vaisā karane meṃ asamartha hai unheṃ pravṛttikā upāya dikhalāneke lie dūsarā kāraṇa kahā hai| kintu yaha daśa prakārake dharmakā kathana samitiyoṃmeṃ pravṛtti karanevāleke pramādakā parihāra karaneke lie kahā hai| śarīrakī sthitike kāraṇakī khoja karaneke lie para kuloṃmeṃ jāte hue bhikṣuko duṣṭa jana gālī-galauja karate haiṃ, upahāsa karate haiṃ, tiraskāra karate haiṃ, mārate-pīṭate haiṃ aura śarīrako toḍa़te-maroḍa़te haiṃ to bhī unake kaluṣatākā utpanna na honā kṣamā hai| jāti ādi madoṃke āveśavaśa honevāle abhimānakā abhāva karanā mārdava hai| mārdavakā artha hai mānakā nāśa karanā| yogoṃkā vakra na honā ārjava hai| prakarṣaprāpta lobhakā tyāga karanā śauca hai| acche puruṣoṃke sātha sādhu vacana bolanā satya hai | śaṃkā-isakā bhāṣāsamitimeṃ antarbhāva hotā hai ? 338] sarvārthasiddhau
[91118 841vedanābhāve'pi dravyakarmasabhāvāpekṣayā pariṣahopacāraḥ kriyate, niravaśeṣanirastajñānātiśaye cintānirodhābhāve'pi tatphalakarmaniharaṇaphalāpekṣayā dhyānopacāravat | athavā-ekādaśa jine 'na saṃti' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ; sopaskāratvātsūtrāṇām | “kalpyo hi vākyaśeṣo vākyaṃ ca vaktaryadhīnam" ityupagamāt | mohodayasahāyīkṛtakṣudādi vedanābhāvāt 'na santi' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | na honese kṣudhādi vedanāke na honepara parīṣaha saṃjñā yukta nahīṃ hai | samādhāna--yaha kathana satya hī hai tathāpi vedanākā abhāva honepara bhī dravyakamake sadabhāvakī apekṣāse yahā~ parīṣahoṃkā upacāra kiyā jātā hai| jisa prakāra samasta jñānāvaraṇake nāśa ho jānepara eka sātha samasta padārthoke rahasyako prakāśita karanevāle kevalajñānātiśayake honepara cintā-nirodhakā abhāva honepara bhī karmoṃke nāśa rūpa usake phalakī apekṣā dhyānakā upacāra kiyā jātā hai usī prakāra yahā~ parīpahoṃkā upacārase kathana jānanā cāhie, athavā jina bhagavān meṃ gyāraha parīṣaha nahīṃ haiṃ' itanā vākyaśeṣa kalpita kara lenā cāhie kyoṃki sūtra upaskārasahita hote haiṃ | 'vākya śeṣakī kalpanā karanī cāhie aura vākya vaktāke adhīna hotā hai' aisā svīkāra bhī kiyā gayā hai| mohake udayakī sahāyatāse honevālī kṣudhādi vedanāoṃkā abhāva honese 'nahīṃ haiṃ' yaha vākyaśeṣa upanyasta kiyā gayā hai|

8855. āha, uktaṃ cāritram | tadanantaramuddiṣṭaṃ yat 'tapasā nirjarā ca' iti tasyedānīṃ isalie use athākhyāta kahate haiṃ | 'atha' śabda 'anantara' arthavartī honese samasta mohanīya karmake kṣaya yā upaśamake anantara vaha āvirbhūta hotā hai yaha ukta kathanakā tātparya hai | athavā isa cāritrakā eka nāma yathākhyāta bhī hai | jisa prakāra ātmākā svabhāva avasthita hai usī prakāra yaha kahā gayā hai, isalie ise yathākhyāta kahate haiṃ | sūtrameṃ āyā huā 'iti' śabda parisamāpti artha meṃ jānanā cāhie| isalie isase yathākhyāta cāritra se samasta karmoke kṣayakī parisamāpti hotī hai yaha jānā jātā hai | uttarottara guṇoṃke prakarṣakā khyāpana karaneke lie sāmāyika, chedosthāpanā ityādi kramase inakā nāmanirdeśa kiyā hai |
viśeṣārtha-cāritra yaha eka prakārakā hokara bhī usake pā~ca bheda vivakṣāviśeṣase kiye gaye haiṃ | sāmāyika meṃ sarvasāvadyakī nivṛttirūpa pariṇāma kī mukhyatā hai | chedopasthāpanā meṃ cāritra laganevāle doṣoṃke parimārjanakī mukhyatā hai | parihāraviśuddhi cāritra aise saṃyatake hotā hai ja tīsa varṣataka gṛhastha avasthā meṃ sukhapūrvaka bitākara saṃyata honepara tīrthaṃkara pādamūlakī paricaryā karate hue āṭha varṣa taka pratyākhyānapūrva kā adhyayana karatā hai| yaha jantuoṃkī rakṣā kaise karanī cāhie, ve kisa dravyake nimittase kisa kṣetra aura kisa kālameṃ viśeṣataḥ utpanna hote haiṃ, jīvoṃkī yoni aura janma kitane prakāra ke hote haiṃ ityādi bātoṃko bhale prakāra jānatā hai | yaha pramādarahita, mahābalaśālī, karmokī mahānirjarā karanevālā aura ati 'duṣkara caryākā anuṣṭhāna karanevālā hotā hai | tathā yaha tīnoṃ saṃdhyākāloṃko choḍa़kara do kosa gamana karanevālā hotā hai | ina saba kāraṇoṃ se isa saṃyatake aiso sāmarthya utpanna hotī hai jisake balase yaha anya jīvoṃko bādhā pahu~cāye binā caryā karanemeṃ samartha hotā hai| sūkṣmasāmparāya aura yathākhyāta cāritrakā artha spaṣṭa hī hai | isa prakāra vivakṣābhedase eka cāritra pā~ca prakārakā kahā gayā hai |
inase se sāmāyika aura chedopasthāpanākī jaghanya viśuddhilabdhi sabase alpa hotī hai | isase parihāraviśuddhi cāritrakī jaghanya viśuddhilabdhi anantaguṇī hotī hai| isase isīkī utkṛṣṭa viśuddhilabdhi anantaguṇī hotī hai| isase sāmāyika aura chedopasthāpanākī utkṛṣṭa viśuddhilabdhi anantaguṇī hotī hai| isase sūkṣmasāmparāya cāritrakī jaghanya viśuddhilabdhi anantaguṇī hotī haiṃ | isase isakī utkṛṣṭa viśuddhilabdhi anantaguṇī hotī hai | isase yathākhyāta cāritrakī viśuddhilabdhi eka prakārakī hokara bhī anantaguṇī hotī hai| yahī kāraṇa hai ki sūtrameṃ sāmāyika chedopasthāpanā ityādi kramase ina pā~coṃkā nāma nirdeśa kiyā hai| pahale dasa prakārake dharmakā nirdeśa karate samaya saṃyamadharma kaha āye haiṃ, isalie cāritrakā antarbhāva usameṃ ho jāneke kāraṇa yahā~ isakā alaga se kathana karanekī āvaśyakatā nahīṃ hotī hai phira bhī samasta karmakā kṣaya cāritrase hotā hai yaha dikhalāneke lie yahā~ cāritrakā pṛthakrūpase vyākhyāna kiyā hai |

8908. ta ete daśa samyagdṛṣṭayādayaḥ kramaśo'saṃkhyeyaguṇanirjarāḥ | tadyathā bhavyaḥ pacendriyasaṃjñī paryāptakaḥ pūrvoktakālalabdhyādisahāyaḥ pariṇāmaviśuddhayā vardhamānaḥ krameṇāpūrvakaraṇādisoaura jinake svalpamātrāmeṃ karmokā paripācana ho rahā hai aise ve apane ātmapradeśoṃke phailanese karmarajako pariśātana karaneko śaktivāle daṇḍa, kapāṭa, pratara aura lokapūraṇa samudghātako cāra samayoṃke dvārā karake anantara pradeśoṃ ke visarpaṇakā saṃkoca karake tathā śeṣa cāra karmokī sthitiko samāna karake apane pūrva śarīrapramāṇa hokara sūkṣma kāyayogake dvārā sūkṣmakriyāpratipāti dhyānako svīkāra karate haiṃ| isake bāda cauthe samucchinna kriyānivati dhyānako ārambha karate haiṃ| isameṃ prāṇāpānake pracārarūpa kriyākā tathā saba prakārake kāyayoga, vacanayoga aura manoyogake dvārā honevālo ātmapradeśa parispandarūpa kriyākā uccheda ho jānese ise samucchinnakriyānivarti dhyāna kahate haiṃ| isa samucchinnakriyānivati dhyānameṃ saba prakārake karmabandhake āsravakā nirodha ho jānese tathā bākīke bace saba karmoke nāśa karane kī śaktike utpanna ho jānese ayogikevalī ke saṃsārake saba prakārake duḥkhajālake sambandhakā uccheda karanevālā sampūrṇa yathākhyātacāritra, jñāna aura darśanarūpa sākṣāt mokṣakā kāraṇa utpanna hotā hai| ve ayogikevalī bhagavān usa samaya dhyānātiśayarūpa agnike dvārā saba prakārake mala-kalaṃkabandhanako jalākara aura kiṭṭa dhātu va pāṣāṇakā nāśakara śaddha hae sone ke samāna apane ātmāko prāptakara parinirvāṇako prāpta hote haiṃ| isa prakāra yaha donoṃ prakārakā tapa nūtana karmoke āsravake nirodhakā hetu honese saṃvarakā kāraṇa hai aura prāktana karmarūpī rajake nāśa karanekā hetu honese nirjarākā bhī hetu hai|

siddhāntācārya paṃ. phūlacandra śāstrī (san 1601-1962) bhāratīya manīṣiyoṃ meṃ, viśeṣakara jainadarśana evaṃ siddhānta ke kṣetra meṃ, siddhāntācārya paṃ. phūlacandra śāstrī apanī bahuāyāmī śāstra-vidyā ke lie vikhyāta rahe haiṃ| cintana-manana tathā sāhitya-sādhanā meṃ satata saṃlagna paṇḍitajī kī rāṣṭrīya evaṃ sāmājika utthāna ke āndolanoṃ meṃ viśeṣa bhūmikā rahī hai| bhārata choḍa़o' āndolana meṃ āpane jela-yātrā bhī kī| paṇḍitajī āgama ke marma ke vicakṣaṇa vyākhyātā rahe haiṃ| nirjīva gatānugatikatā ke mūla meṃ paiṭhī, vilupta tejasvitā ko ubhārakara jainadarśana ke lokopakārī sārvajanika rūpa ke udghāṭana tathā usake pracāra-prasāra meṃ āpakā sāhasika netṛtva aneka daśakoṃ se kriyāśīla rahā hai| lalitapura (u. pra.) ke nikaṭa hī eka choṭe-se gā~va silāvana meṃ janme paṇḍitajī ne aneka saṃsthāoṃ meṃ adhyāpanadāyitva ke saphala nirvāha ke kāraṇa apanī eka lambī śiṣya-paramparā ko prabhāvita kiyā hai| dharmādhyāpaka ke rūpa meṃ āpa hindū viśvavidyālaya vārāṇasī se bhī sambaddha rahe| darśana, siddhānta evaṃ ācāra viṣayaka kitanī hī carcāoṃ meṃ āpane apane agādha jñāna se vidvajjagat ko camatkṛta kiyā hai| maulika racanāe~-1. jaina tattvamīmāṃsā, 2. jainadharma aura varṇa-vyavasthā, 3. viśvaśānti aura aparigrahavāda, 4. varṇa, jāti aura dharma| sampādita grantha-pacāsa se adhika| inameṃ dhavalā aura jayadhavalā ke aneka khaṇḍa, prameyaralamālā, paṃcādhyāyī, mahābandha, samayasāra-kalaśa, labdhisāra-kṣapaṇāsāra, ātmānuśāsana ādi āgama-sāhitya ke pramukha grantha sammilita haiṃ|
